_help: Maven's ~/.m2/settings.xml. Each host is a <server> id, which Maven matches exactly against a repository's or mirror's <id> in the build. Each uses 'user_env'+'pass_env'. A brace in a value is written \\{ so Maven does not read it as an encrypted {...} value. This file stores ENV VAR NAMES, not secrets. Writes MERGE: only that <server> element is replaced; every other line, comment and element is kept byte for byte.
